name: Spain (Bourbon ensign, 1760–1785)
description: A white field with the royal arms of Spain as modified in 1760, crowned and surrounded by the collar of the Golden Fleece, in the centre.
history: The Bourbon white ensign with the arms as modified by Charles III in 1760, which dropped the collar of the Holy Spirit and added the quarters of Farnese and Medici. It was replaced by the red and yellow naval ensign under the Royal Decree of 28 May 1785.
